params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='C:\HeavenServices\worker-fabric'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root, "$root\shared", "$root\artifacts" | Out-Null

$dockerfile=@'
FROM node:22-bookworm-slim
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV HOME=/home/node
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
       ca-certificates curl git jq ripgrep python3 python3-pip python3-venv \
       build-essential procps file less \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN mkdir -p /workspace /shared /artifacts \
    && chown -R node:node /workspace /shared /artifacts
USER node
WORKDIR /workspace
CMD ["sleep","infinity"]
'@
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$root\Dockerfile",$dockerfile,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

$compose=@'
name: heaven-worker-fabric

x-base-worker: &base-worker
  build:
    context: .
    dockerfile: Dockerfile
  image: heaven/worker-node22:2026.09
  restart: unless-stopped
  init: true
  tty: false
  stdin_open: false
  pids_limit: 512
  cpus: 4.0
  mem_limit: 2g
  working_dir: /workspace
  environment:
    HEAVEN_FABRIC: "1"
    HEAVEN_TIER: "base"
    CI: "1"
  networks:
    - fabric
  healthcheck:
    test: ["CMD-SHELL", "node --version >/dev/null && python3 --version >/dev/null && git --version >/dev/null"]
    interval: 30s
    timeout: 5s
    retries: 3
    start_period: 10s

x-burst-worker: &burst-worker
  build:
    context: .
    dockerfile: Dockerfile
  image: heaven/worker-node22:2026.09
  restart: unless-stopped
  init: true
  tty: false
  stdin_open: false
  pids_limit: 384
  cpus: 2.0
  mem_limit: 1g
  working_dir: /workspace
  environment:
    HEAVEN_FABRIC: "1"
    HEAVEN_TIER: "burst"
    CI: "1"
  networks:
    - fabric
  healthcheck:
    test: ["CMD-SHELL", "node --version >/dev/null && python3 --version >/dev/null && git --version >/dev/null"]
    interval: 30s
    timeout: 5s
    retries: 3
    start_period: 10s

services:
  worker01:
    <<: *base-worker
    container_name: heaven-worker-01
    hostname: heaven-worker-01
    labels:
      heaven.role: worker
      heaven.tier: base
      heaven.slot: "01"
    volumes:
      - worker01:/workspace
      - ./shared:/shared
      - ./artifacts:/artifacts

  worker02:
    <<: *base-worker
    container_name: heaven-worker-02
    hostname: heaven-worker-02
    labels:
      heaven.role: worker
      heaven.tier: base
      heaven.slot: "02"
    volumes:
      - worker02:/workspace
      - ./shared:/shared
      - ./artifacts:/artifacts

  worker03:
    <<: *base-worker
    container_name: heaven-worker-03
    hostname: heaven-worker-03
    labels:
      heaven.role: worker
      heaven.tier: base
      heaven.slot: "03"
    volumes:
      - worker03:/workspace
      - ./shared:/shared
      - ./artifacts:/artifacts

  worker04:
    <<: *base-worker
    container_name: heaven-worker-04
    hostname: heaven-worker-04
    labels:
      heaven.role: worker
      heaven.tier: base
      heaven.slot: "04"
    volumes:
      - worker04:/workspace
      - ./shared:/shared
      - ./artifacts:/artifacts

  worker05:
    <<: *burst-worker
    profiles: ["burst"]
    container_name: heaven-worker-05
    hostname: heaven-worker-05
    labels:
      heaven.role: worker
      heaven.tier: burst
      heaven.slot: "05"
    volumes:
      - worker05:/workspace
      - ./shared:/shared
      - ./artifacts:/artifacts

  worker06:
    <<: *burst-worker
    profiles: ["burst"]
    container_name: heaven-worker-06
    hostname: heaven-worker-06
    labels:
      heaven.role: worker
      heaven.tier: burst
      heaven.slot: "06"
    volumes:
      - worker06:/workspace
      - ./shared:/shared
      - ./artifacts:/artifacts

  worker07:
    <<: *burst-worker
    profiles: ["burst"]
    container_name: heaven-worker-07
    hostname: heaven-worker-07
    labels:
      heaven.role: worker
      heaven.tier: burst
      heaven.slot: "07"
    volumes:
      - worker07:/workspace
      - ./shared:/shared
      - ./artifacts:/artifacts

  worker08:
    <<: *burst-worker
    profiles: ["burst"]
    container_name: heaven-worker-08
    hostname: heaven-worker-08
    labels:
      heaven.role: worker
      heaven.tier: burst
      heaven.slot: "08"
    volumes:
      - worker08:/workspace
      - ./shared:/shared
      - ./artifacts:/artifacts

networks:
  fabric:
    name: heaven-worker-fabric
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  worker01:
  worker02:
  worker03:
  worker04:
  worker05:
  worker06:
  worker07:
  worker08:
'@
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$root\docker-compose.yml",$compose,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

$manifest=[ordered]@{
  schema='heaven-worker-fabric-v1'
  host='heaven'
  created='2026-09-29'
  runtime='Docker Engine inside Ubuntu WSL2'
  image='heaven/worker-node22:2026.09'
  base_workers=4
  burst_workers=4
  base_limits=[ordered]@{cpus=4;memory='2g';pids=512}
  burst_limits=[ordered]@{cpus=2;memory='1g';pids=384}
  ports_published=$false
  host_secrets_mounted=$false
  shared_path='C:\HeavenServices\worker-fabric\shared'
  artifacts_path='C:\HeavenServices\worker-fabric\artifacts'
  notes='Base workers auto-restart with Docker. Burst workers are opt-in. Workspaces are isolated named volumes.'
}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$root\fabric.json",($manifest|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6),(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

$manager=@'
param(
  [ValidateSet('START','STOP','STATUS','BUILD','VERIFY','BURST-ON','BURST-OFF','EXEC','RUNALL')]
  [string]$Action='STATUS',
  [ValidateSet('worker01','worker02','worker03','worker04','worker05','worker06','worker07','worker08')]
  [string]$Worker='worker01',
  [Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
  [string[]]$Command
)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$LinuxRoot='/mnt/c/HeavenServices/worker-fabric'

function Invoke-Ubuntu([string]$Script) {
  $b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($Script))
  & wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "echo $b64 | base64 -d | bash"
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw "Ubuntu command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
}

switch($Action){
  'BUILD' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose build" }
  'START' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose up -d worker01 worker02 worker03 worker04" }
  'STOP' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst stop" }
  'BURST-ON' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst up -d worker05 worker06 worker07 worker08" }
  'BURST-OFF' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst stop worker05 worker06 worker07 worker08" }
  'STATUS' {
    Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst ps && echo && docker stats --no-stream --format 'table {{.Name}}\t{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}\t{{.PIDs}}' heaven-worker-01 heaven-worker-02 heaven-worker-03 heaven-worker-04 2>/dev/null || true"
  }
  'VERIFY' {
    Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && for w in worker01 worker02 worker03 worker04; do echo ===$w===; docker compose exec -T $w sh -lc 'hostname; node -v; python3 --version; git --version; rg --version | head -1'; done"
  }
  'EXEC' {
    if(-not $Command -or $Command.Count -eq 0){ throw 'EXEC requires a command after the worker name.' }
    $cmd=($Command -join ' ')
    $inner=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($cmd))
    Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst exec -T $Worker bash -lc 'echo $inner | base64 -d | bash'"
  }
  'RUNALL' {
    if(-not $Command -or $Command.Count -eq 0){ throw 'RUNALL requires a command.' }
    $cmd=($Command -join ' ')
    $inner=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($cmd))
    Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && for w in worker01 worker02 worker03 worker04; do (echo ===$w===; docker compose exec -T $w bash -lc 'echo $inner | base64 -d | bash') & done; wait"
  }
}
'@
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1",$manager,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

$readme=@'
# Heaven Worker Fabric

Eight isolated Linux worker slots hosted on heaven through Docker in the existing Ubuntu WSL2 runtime.

Base workers heaven-worker-01 through heaven-worker-04 use up to 4 CPUs and 2 GiB RAM each.
Burst workers heaven-worker-05 through heaven-worker-08 use up to 2 CPUs and 1 GiB RAM each and are opt-in.
No ports are published.
No host credentials or secret directories are mounted.
Each worker has a private persistent /workspace volume.
shared and artifacts are common exchange directories.
The image includes Node 22, Python 3, Git, ripgrep, jq, curl, and build-essential.

Windows management examples:
powershell -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 STATUS
powershell -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 START
powershell -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 VERIFY
powershell -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 BURST-ON
powershell -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 BURST-OFF
powershell -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 EXEC worker01 "node -v"

The Heaven Local Bridge can call the same script with proc_run. Keep secrets on heaven2; pass only task material or non-secret build inputs into these workers.
'@
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$root\README.md",$readme,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

$validate="cd /mnt/c/HeavenServices/worker-fabric && docker compose config -q"
$b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($validate))
& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "echo $b64 | base64 -d | bash"
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'docker compose config failed' }

$run="cd /mnt/c/HeavenServices/worker-fabric && docker compose build && docker compose up -d worker01 worker02 worker03 worker04 && docker compose ps"
$b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($run))
& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "echo $b64 | base64 -d | bash"
exit $LASTEXITCODE
